# PINDÉ Window System Supply — Full Content

## Company Overview
PINDÉ (Pinde Doors and Windows (Chongqing) Co., LTD) is a B2B window system material supplier based in Chongqing, China. We supply aluminium and FRP window-and-door profile systems, machined components, and glass-free CKD (completely knocked down) kits to window manufacturers, profile-system fabricators, importers, and project procurement teams across Russian-speaking markets (Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan).

NOT a retail window shop. Glazing, final assembly, testing, and installation stay local in the destination market.

Manufacturing base: 100,000 m² integrated campus in Tongliang District, Chongqing. The manufacturing group's roots date to 2002.

## Two Material Platforms

### Aluminium Systems (Commercial Mainline)
Thermally broken aluminium window-and-door systems using 6063-T5 alloy with PA66GF25 (polyamide 66 with 25% glass fibre) thermal break strips. Surface-finished profiles supplied as complete system kits for local cutting and fabrication, or upgraded to project-specific machined and CKD kits.

Launch package includes:
- Frame, sash, mullion, and glazing-bead profiles
- Thermal breaks, EPDM gaskets, cleats, and connectors
- Drainage parts, compatible hardware schedule, and complete BOM
- Processing drawings, assembly instructions, and spare-parts list

Key specifications:
- PA66GF25 thermal conductivity: 0.3 W/m·K (vs aluminium 160 W/m·K — 500x reduction)
- 6063-T5 aluminium alloy, minimum wall thickness 1.4mm
- Surface finishes: Akzo Nobel powder coating, anodising, wood-grain
- EPDM rubber seals
- Compatible hardware: SIEGENIA, G-U, Roto, KIN LONG
- Extrusion: 3,600-ton press, automated cutting at ±0.5mm tolerance

### FRP & Aluminium-GRPU Composite Systems (Engineering Programme)
Two composite routes are managed in this family. PD75 is a 75mm aluminium-composite window platform with inner and outer aluminium shells structurally joined by a 45mm Ultra FRP Core made from pultruded glass-fibre reinforced polyurethane (GRPU). Continuous reinforcement supports load transfer, low conductivity interrupts the metal heat path, and material damping helps reduce vibration transfer. It is available in outward-opening and inward tilt-turn configurations. The full-FRP route uses pultruded glass-fibre profiles throughout. Each programme is released against its own defined BOM, connection method, and project test plan.

Package includes:
- Frame, sash, mullion, and glazing-bead profile set
- Corner joints, seals, and approved fastening interfaces
- Cutting, drilling, bonding, and dust-control parameters
- Pilot kits, first-article inspection, and fabrication training

PD75 reference specifications:
- 75mm nominal platform depth
- 45mm Ultra FRP Core: pultruded GRPU structural and thermal element
- 1.8mm aluminium profile wall in the source system catalogue
- Outward-opening and inward tilt-turn configurations
- Source-catalogue performance values apply only to the identified specimen and glazing build-up; destination-market claims require project-specific whole-window verification

IMPORTANT: Thermal, structural, and weather-performance values are stated only for a verified specimen, glazing build-up, and test scope. Unverified values remain project targets — not sales claims.

## Supply Formats (P1—P3)

### P1 — Complete System Kit (Default)
From Chongqing: Finished profiles, gaskets, cleats, connectors, drainage parts, BOM, and fabrication documents.
Kept local: Cutting, machining, hardware, glazing, assembly, QA, and installation.
Best fit: Established fabricators with cutting and corner-joining capability.

### P2 — Cut-to-Length & Machined (Upgrade)
From Chongqing: Optimised cutting, drainage and lock machining, CNC work, and part identification.
Kept local: Corner joining, hardware, glazing, adjustment, final inspection, and installation.
Best fit: Factories that need capacity relief or controlled first production.

### P3 — Glass-Free CKD Kit (Project)
From Chongqing: Machined profiles packed by opening with seals, joints, selected hardware, and a spares pack.
Kept local: Final dimensions, assembly, insulating-glass units, commissioning, compliance, and site work.
Best fit: Paid pilot runs, time-sensitive projects, and lower-capability production cells.

## Fabricator Enablement Process
1. Qualify the system — Review equipment, annual volume, current systems, window schedule, glazing, target-country requirements
2. Freeze the reference build — Agree system code, representative sizes, BOM, interfaces, performance evidence, responsibility matrix
3. Run a paid pilot — Section samples and corner joints, then 3-10 glass-free kits for local fabrication and testing
4. Scale by evidence — Micro-batch → project batch → repeat programme, only after yield, fit, logistics, and claims data are accepted

## Responsibility Split
PINDÉ Chongqing: System engineering and BOM control, profile production/finishing/batch QA, optional cutting/CNC/kit identification, packing/documentation/replacement parts.
Local fabricator: Final opening and dimension confirmation, locally sourced glazing and approved hardware, assembly/adjustment/finished-window QA, national conformity/installation/first-line service.

Shipping: The Yuxinou freight railway connects Chongqing with Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Russia. The homepage route map shows indicative rail transit of approximately 7-20 days by destination. Times are not guaranteed and vary with schedules, consolidation, customs, destination, and last-mile arrangements. Rail-compatible export packing is available; FCA, CIP, and DAP are quoted per shipment, and freight and import charges are never presented as fixed long-term rates.

## Engineering Deliverables
- System definition: Profile sections, kg/m, BOM, colour/batch rules, gasket/connector mapping
- Fabrication package: Cutting/machining drawings, drainage, joint method, tooling, process parameters, inspection points
- Evidence register: Report number, laboratory, specimen size, glazing, hardware, date, exact scope a result supports
- Launch support: Samples, first-article review, remote training, issue traceability, change control, replenishment planning

Cold-climate suitability is confirmed system by system. Frame depth, thermal-break width, or material conductivity alone is not used to infer whole-window performance.

## Certifications & Testing
- ISO 9001: Quality Management
- ISO 14001: Environmental Management
- CE: European Conformity
- AS2047: Australian Standard — windows and external glazed doors
- AS1288: Glass in Buildings
- NFRC: North American Fenestration Rating
- 60+ Patents
- Testing standards: AS/NZS 4420 (air/water/wind), EN 12207/12208/12210, EN ISO 10077 (thermal), NFRC

In-house testing laboratory: Air permeability, water tightness, wind resistance, structural, thermal, acoustic.

## EAEU / EAC Certification
Russia, Kazakhstan, and Belarus require separate confirmation of the applicable national route, importer/applicant, sample scope, and labelling. No single generic EAEU certificate serves as universal approval for all countries. Classification and documentation are aligned with the actual supply form before first shipment.

## Commercial Terms
Initial quotations: FCA, CIP, or DAP terms with freight, duty, and tax shown separately. New programmes start with prepayment; credit terms considered only after successful repeat business.

## Target Markets
Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan, and other CIS/Eurasia markets.
